_doc: Round 5 paint-over for idle at 144 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/idle_144.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (0, -1), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: face_base
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'a soft, warm, low-contrast skin ramp ... use a 3-tone warm skin ramp with a soft cheek shadow under the far eye'. Three tones (1 lit, 2 mid, 3 shadow) lit from the upper right; the near cheek and jaw step to 3, a 2 px soft shadow under the far eye.

layers.name: fringe
layers.why: Face critic 4 (head and hair): 'split the fringe into 5-7 tapered clumps with 1 px dark gaps'; FC: 'a warm skin shadow under the bangs'. Six locks from an off-centre parting (x 48), unequal lengths, tips at the brow line so the eyes stay clear.

layers.name: brows
layers.why: Attractiveness 3: 'lock one signature expression (half-lidded smirk, one brow slightly raised)'. The near brow level, set.

layers.name: brows_far
layers.why: as brows: the far brow 1 px raised (the knowing look).

layers.name: eye_near
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'narrow, slanted almond eyes with a heavy 2-3 px dark upper-lash block, a dark-to-warm iris ramp and a small catchlight ... about 1 px narrower and tilted up at the outer corner, a 2 px near-black upper-lash block that runs 1 px past the outer corner, an iris of deep indigo on top, desaturated blue in the middle and a 1 px pale lower catchlight; drop the pure cyan; lift E's lid by 1 px'. Outer corner (left) one row higher than the inner; the lash block 2 rows; the iris 3 rows under it (lid lifted, so the iris shows 3 rows, not 2).

layers.name: eye_far
layers.why: as eye_near, mirrored and foreshortened (6 px): the iris toward the nose so she looks at the viewer; both eyes on one tilt line (outer corners one row up).

layers.name: blush
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'blush should be 1-2 px strokes under the eye, not a blob'. Two short diagonal hatch strokes under each eye.

layers.name: nose
layers.why: one warm tick on the nose's shadow side

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'the default mouth is a 2-3 px asymmetric smirk'; attractiveness 3: 'never ship an open O mouth in a key pose'. A 3 px line with the far corner lifted and darker.

layers.name: strand_face
layers.why: Head and hair 4: 'add 2-3 loose strands that cross the face or the outline': one lock end from the parting falls between the eyes.

layers.name: strands_out
layers.why: Head and hair 4: 'no flyaway strands past the silhouette ... add 2-3 loose strands that cross the face or the outline'. A lock end lifts off the near side and falls.

layers.name: strands_out2
layers.why: as strands_out, far side

layers.name: lock_gaps
layers.why: Head and hair 4: 'no clump separation, no dark gaps between clumps': a 1 px dark gap splits the near side mass into two locks.

layers.name: lock_lights
layers.why: Head and hair 4: 'a hue-shifted ramp ... soft-edged locks': a lit edge on the outer lock, tapering.

layers.name: lock_lights2
layers.why: as lock_lights, inner lock

layers.name: ahoge
layers.why: Head and hair 4 (round 4): '2-3 flyaways plus one ahoge to break the silhouette'. One curled lock off the crown.

layers.name: flyaway3
layers.why: Head and hair 4: '2-3 flyaways ... break the silhouette' (the third, off the near side of the crown).

layers.name: sheen_arc
layers.why: Head and hair 4: 'a lavender sheen arc across the crown (1 px highlight line)'.

layers.name: fist
layers.why: Body critic (round 4, arms and hands 6: 3.4; grip 8: 4.5): 'no hand is visible on the haft, so the glaive floats ... show a 4-5 px fist high on the haft with a gold cuff so the grip reads at 144 and at 80'; the confound note: ours lacks the integrated chain's constructed hand stamps. A 6x6 fist on the haft just under the disc (the render's wrist_left at 81,70): back of the hand to camera, lit from the upper right, a 1 px knuckle crease (4), a warm dark outline (O), a 2 px gold cuff where the wrist enters from the lower left (the forearm runs to the elbow at 67,80). Built the way HD-P01 constructs a fist (palm box, knuckle line, wrist step), drawn by hand.

layers.name: hip_hand
layers.why: Body critic (arms and hands 6): 'the free hand is a detached blue claw at the hip ... put the other hand on the hip with the elbow out'; the claw was the hair tail's azure tips over the hand (now periwinkle, r5_finish). The hand on the hip is drawn as its own shape: back of the hand, fingers grouped and pointing down the hip, one finger split (HD-N02: at most two separations), a warm dark outline against the hip skin (wrist_right at 31,111).

layers.name: tail_tips
layers.why: Body critic (round 4, arms and hands 6): 'the free hand is a detached blue claw at the hip'. It is the hair tail's azure tips fanning under the hip hand. Inside the hip box they take the hair's own violet ramp by value rank (the tips higher up keep the azure, DESIGN's identity).
